title: Issuing a loan laptop
subtitle: Service desk procedure for the loan pool
purpose: Hand a configured loan laptop to a colleague and record the handover so the asset can be chased if it is not returned.
prerequisites: The request has an approved ticket.
A charged laptop from the loan pool is available.
The colleague has signed the loan agreement.

steps.title: Pick the next laptop
steps.detail: Take the oldest return in the pool so the stock rotates and batteries stay exercised.

steps.title: Record the asset tag
steps.detail: Add the tag, the colleague's name and the expected return date to the handover sheet.

steps.title: Confirm the build
steps.detail: Sign in once with a test account to confirm the image, VPN profile and printer queue are present.

steps.title: Sign the handover
steps.detail: Ask the colleague to confirm receipt on the ticket, then attach the signed loan agreement.

sections.heading: Verify it worked
checklist: The ticket shows the asset tag and return date.
The colleague can sign in and reach the intranet.
The pool count on the handover sheet matches the cabinet.

sections.heading: Troubleshooting

rows: Swap it for the next unit and flag this one for repair.
Escalate to the hardware team with the ticket number.
Reimage before handing over; do not install the profile by hand.

sections.note: Never hand over a unit without a signed loan agreement; recovery without one is slow.

sections.heading: If you need more help
paragraphs: Contact the hardware team on ext. 4360 with the ticket number and the asset tag.

footer: Review every 6 months, or when the loan pool process changes.
